text: I have been attempting to resolve my delinquency for almost 2 years. I have received little to no assistance from the servicer in regards to getting information about the homeowners assistance fund. The servicer denied me for their mortgage assistance after telling me that I would be able to get assistance. They referred me to a state agency for assistance after denying me and then started foreclosure proceedings. While working with the state agency, i called the servicer on several occasions to get information was always given incorrect or inconsistent information. My servicer has paused foreclosure proceedings but still will not let me make payments, they continue to give me incorrect information and fail to communicate with the state agency that they recommended I work with. They even sent a message to the state agency that stated that do not participate in that program. After raising this concern to another representative in the loss mitigation department, I was told that they actually do participate. The agent promised to give me a call back on the next day so that we may have a conference call with the state agency, however she never called. When I called the servicer in order to reach that agent, I was told that they could not connect me to her and that the earliest that I would be able to speak with her would be in two weeks.This type of event has happened week after week of attempting to work with the servicer.This servicer has continuously failed to follow up and to provide the necessary information or assistance that I need in order to bring my loan current. This lack of attention and assistance is creating a greater financial burden for me as I am unable to make payments and continue to accrue interest on my my outstanding principal and delinquency amounts.
